en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umery, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
regarding the man who prays the optional Salāt in the cities, and he is upon a riding animal, wherever he may be facing with it’. So heasws said: ‘Yes, there is no problem’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from ’Abd al- Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
about a man who performs optional Salah (prayer) in the cities while on the stumper and to whatever direction it faces. He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, it is not harmful.’”
